answer: Hash the receipt, publish the hash, reveal the payload after the epoch closes, then let peers attest the revealed work. Split the payout across attesters so disagreement dilutes it instead of voiding it. Assume the attacker reads every rule: a voyage of sock puppets copies the commit step, but each one still has to reveal a distinct payload from a separate vault and survive peer review. Rewards vest over later epochs, so a farm caught at the wharf loses everything not yet released.
